description: Free. Download a public video or audio link into AwesomeVideo and get a fileId (same as upload {action:'start'}), without downloading it yourself. Accepts direct https/http file links (chat attachment URLs, CDNs, S3 presigned URLs), Google Drive share links (large-file confirm page handled), Dropbox share links, and OneDrive links. Up to 2048 MB when the host sends Content-Length (streamed to storage), 80 MB otherwise (422 limit_exceeded, charged:false). YouTube, TikTok, and Instagram links are refused with 422: upload the file instead. Private, local, and non-standard-port addresses are blocked. Up to 30 per hour. caption_video accepts sourceUrl directly, so you only need this to reuse one file across several tools.

api_key.description: Only for a connection without an Authorization header: the token create_key returned (av_live_...). Pass it on every call to use that key in this same session, no reconnect or config change. Ignored when the connection already sends a key. It works like a password: create a new key if this conversation is shared.

filename.description: File name to store, with extension (e.g. talk.mp4); used for the content type and download name. Max 200 characters.

hasMore.description: true when more items are available (paginated lists).

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor for the next page (paginated lists).

result.description: The value, when the tool returns something other than an object.
